unesco.org
Launch of UNESCO Open Science Platform
3-4 分鐘

UNESCO is pleased to announce the public launch of the UNESCO Open Science Platform during the UN Open Source Week 2026, from 22 to 26 June 2026 in New York. Developed in partnership with the United Nations International Computing Centre (UNICC), the platform is released as free and open-source software and is built on open technologies, including a customized implementation of CERN's InvenioRDM, an open source framework for building large-scale digital academic repositories and platforms, as a core component. With an initial focus on research produced or supported by UNESCO's Natural Sciences Family, the platform aims to promote UNESCO-related knowledge and support the implementation of the UNESCO Recommendation on Open Science.

Explore the platform

Tracking global progress on open science

This platform responds to Member States’ need for practical tools to implement the UNESCO Recommendation on Open Science. It features interactive dashboards that visualize progress across a range of open science dimensions in UNESCO Member States, including policies, infrastructure, capacity building and incentives. They are based on quantitative and qualitative data collected through UNESCO's first consultation on the implementation of the Recommendation on Open Science. The dashboards include cross-country visualizations, country profiles and a semantic cloud of key challenges in the implementation of open science, helping users explore global, regional and national developments and identify areas for further action.

By bringing UNESCO-related scientific publications and other research outputs together with data on global open science progress, including the finding that around 75% of responding Member States have open science infrastructure at the national or institutional level, the platform helps make knowledge more discoverable, accessible and useful for evidence-based-decision-making.

Shaofeng Hu, Director of the Division of Ethics, Research and Technology, UNESCO Sciences Sector

A platform dedicated to promoting open access to UNESCO research products

This platform brings together a growing collection of research outputs from UNESCO science programmes, awards and fellowship initiatives, making them easier to discover, access and explore through a single search interface. The current collection focuses primarily on publications, such as journal articles, books and reports, with additional products, such as research data, to be integrated over time. Users can access detailed metadata, identify the open access status of resources and explore impact indicators, including scholarly and patent citations. 

Translating scientific knowledge into accessible insights

To bridge the gap between research, policy and society, the platform features curated highlights and illustrated plain language summaries that translate complex findings on issues such as climate change, water resource management and gender gap in science, into clear, actionable insights, useful for decision-makers and non-specialist audiences. These features will be updated regularly to reflect the latest research evidence.

codex_translated_article_markdown_zh:
unesco.org
UNESCO 開放科學平台正式上線
3-4 分鐘

UNESCO 很高興宣布，UNESCO 開放科學平台將於 2026 年 6 月 22 日至 26 日在紐約舉行的聯合國開放原始碼週 2026 期間正式公開上線。該平台與聯合國國際計算中心（UNICC）合作開發，以自由與開放原始碼軟體形式發布，並建構於開放技術之上，包括以 CERN 的 InvenioRDM 客製化實作作為核心元件；InvenioRDM 是用於建置大型數位學術典藏庫與平台的開放原始碼框架。平台初期聚焦於 UNESCO 自然科學領域所產出或支持的研究，目標是推廣與 UNESCO 相關的知識，並支持《UNESCO 開放科學建議書》的落實。

探索平台

追蹤全球開放科學進展

這個平台回應會員國在落實《UNESCO 開放科學建議書》時，對實用工具的需求。平台提供互動式儀表板，將 UNESCO 會員國在多項開放科學面向上的進展視覺化，包括政策、基礎設施、能力建構與誘因。這些儀表板以 UNESCO 首次針對《開放科學建議書》落實情況進行諮詢時所蒐集的量化與質化資料為基礎。儀表板包含跨國視覺化、國家概況，以及開放科學落實過程中關鍵挑戰的語意雲，協助使用者探索全球、區域與國家層級的發展，並找出後續行動的重點領域。

透過將 UNESCO 相關的科學出版品與其他研究成果，和全球開放科學進展資料整合在一起，包括約 75% 回覆的會員國已在國家或機構層級具備開放科學基礎設施這項發現，該平台有助於讓知識更容易被發現、取得，並能更有效用於以證據為基礎的決策。

UNESCO 科學部門倫理、研究與科技司司長 Shaofeng Hu

一個致力於促進 UNESCO 研究成果開放取用的平台

這個平台匯集了來自 UNESCO 科學計畫、獎項與獎助研究倡議中日益增加的研究成果，讓使用者能透過單一搜尋介面更容易發現、取用與探索。現有收藏主要聚焦於出版品，例如期刊文章、書籍與報告；其他成果項目，例如研究資料，將隨時間逐步整合進來。使用者可以查看詳細後設資料、辨識資源的開放取用狀態，並探索影響力指標，包括學術引用與專利引用。

將科學知識轉化為易懂的洞見

為了彌合研究、政策與社會之間的落差，這個平台提供精選重點與搭配插圖的白話摘要，將氣候變遷、水資源管理、科學領域的性別落差等議題中的複雜發現，轉化為清楚且可付諸行動的洞見，供決策者與非專業讀者參考。這些內容將定期更新，以反映最新的研究證據。

更多資訊
